description: Read the PUBLIC view of a published Digital Product Passport hosted by Aeroz, by its GS1 Digital Link (e.g. https://id.aeroz.io/01/09506000134352/21/ABC123) or its passport id (dpp_...). Returns the signed passport fields everyone may see, the version and its date, recall status and the item's links. Fields restricted to repairers, recyclers or authorities are listed as withheld, never shown. This reads the record only: it does NOT prove the physical item in front of you is genuine — use verify_chip with a fresh chip tap for that. A link from another resolver is refused, not fetched. Works without an API key. Passports of sandbox organisations are not public in production.

date.description: Optional: the passport as it stood on this ISO-8601 date (with dpp_id).

digital_link.description: A GS1 Digital Link on id.aeroz.io (query string is ignored).

dpp_id.description: A passport id, dpp_ followed by 26 characters.

name: get_passport
title: Read a product passport
